thread:
Maya: Quick sync — need to finalize CTAs and lead routing for Hosted/Dedicated/Private pages before Wed launch. Current asks: hero tone, primary CTA, and lead bucket mapping.
Sam: +1. Can we shorten the hero headline to something punchy? Suggestion: "Predictable LLM inference at scale" — 5 words. Thoughts?
Jon: Love that. Also want to confirm whether we include a one-sentence benchmark line under the hero (p95 latency / cost)? Could be: "p95 < 90ms on common prompts" — but might be too specific.
Liam: Design constraints: keep hero copy to 2 lines on desktop, 3 on mobile. Need primary and secondary CTAs with clear hierarchy. Primary should be a self-serve CTA for Hosted; secondary can point to Dedicated/Private routes.
Maya: Lead routing proposal: Hosted -> self-serve onboarding (HubSpot form + product email), Dedicated -> Sales (AE queue), Private -> Enterprise (Security intake + sales engineering). Add hidden field deployment_type for deterministic routing.
Sam: Implementation note for eng: example tracking params we can use:
```
/signup?utm_source=site&deployment=hosted
form.hidden['deployment_type']='hosted'
```
Can engineering support that by Monday?
deploy-bot: dev-traffic-team — we can add query param parsing and HubSpot mapping. ETA: Monday deploy window. Will return a PR link.
Jon: Copy variants for CTAs:
- Hosted (primary): "Get started — free credits"
- Dedicated: "Request dedicated capacity"
- Private: "Talk to sales about Private"
Also propose microcopy under CTAs for trust: "SLA-backed latency, self-serve sandbox" — short.
Sam: Let's A/B test hero headline vs. "Serve LLMs with predictable latency and cost" — will set up experiment and tracking events with growth.
Liam: Pushed a draft into Figma: https://figma.com/file/hosted-hero-prototypes — left comments on spacing and CTA states.
Maya: Great, thanks. Sam — please drop the final 3 hero variants + CTA text into the PR description. Jon — add the benchmark line copy options to the doc. Liam — please export hero mockups for mobile. I'll consolidate and update the site copy doc by EOD. :thumbsup:
